findings.body: `toml::Table` does not implement `FromStr`, so this test will fail to compile. Use `toml::from_str::<toml::Table>(crate::config::DEFAULTS)` instead.
findings.existing_code:
let config: crate::config::types::Config = crate::config::DEFAULTS
            .parse::<toml::Table>()
            .expect("defaults parse")
            .try_into()
            .expect("defaults deserialize");
findings.title: Use `toml::from_str` instead of `parse::<toml::Table>`

findings.body: The $0.00598 and $0.00556 figures match the z-ai/glm-5.2 test calculation, not qwen/qwen3.8-max. At $2.00/$6.00 per million tokens, a call with comparable token counts would cost far more than $0.00598, so this comment is misleading.
findings.title: Correct the cost comparison in the qwen entry comment

value.summary: The change adds model prices and tests. A new test will not compile because `toml::Table` does not implement `FromStr`, and the qwen entry's comment contains cost figures that belong to a different model.
